candidates.name: Seven Oaks Doors and Hardware Inc. (Seven Oaks Commercial Door and Hardware Solutions)
candidates.partition_evidence: Site lists Toilet Partitions as a service and says it sells, delivers and installs them. Article titles include 'Expert Bathroom Partition Installers at Seven Oaks' and 'Toilet Partitions for Tyson Foods, Monroe NC'. It also has a toilet partition request form.
red_flags: No partition brands named on the pages read
candidates.reason: Commercial door, hardware and partition company based in Locust (about 25 miles east of Charlotte). Its own site says it installs bathroom partitions for schools, offices and industrial clients across NC and SC, including Monroe and Rock Hill.

license.name: Seven Oaks Doors and Hardware Inc. (Seven Oaks Commercial Door and Hardware Solutions)
license.registry: North Carolina Licensing Board for General Contractors (NCLBGC) public license search, portal.nclbgc.org/Public/Search
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Company-name searches for 'Seven Oaks', 'Seven Oaks Door' and 'Seven Oaks Commercial', a phone search for 704-485-2014, and company 'Seven'/'Door' with city Locust returned no matching license. The only 'Seven Oaks' hit is Seven Oaks Construction, LLC (L.66423, License Not Active), a different company. NC requires a GC license only for jobs at or above the state threshold, so a partitions-only job below it may not need one; confirm with NCLBGC. The company site (https://sevenoakshardware.com/) gives the name 'Seven Oaks Door and Hardware Inc.', phone 704-485-2014 and toll-free 1-800-535-7972, says it sells, delivers and installs toilet partitions, and lists no license number. Base city (Locust) is not stated on that page.

candidates.name: Burgess Sales & Supply, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Product categories include Division 10. The services page says 'Installation available for products that we furnish'. Neither page mentions toilet partitions, and the Division 10 page could not be loaded.
red_flags: No explicit toilet partition mention found
candidates.reason: Charlotte door, frame and hardware supplier with a Division 10 line that installs the products it furnishes. Whether it handles partitions is unproven.
